title: top15_items_build_1
licence: Wikidata structured data CC0 1.0; only wikiDataId values copied. Official register/geometry used as identity reference only; no share-alike source admitted, no SOURCES block.
method: Global exact own-code statement discovery on QLever; deprecated ranks excluded; no parent or name-only code binding. Unique literal own code, current matching own P31 class, current same-state P131 chain, every Earth point inside retained unrepaired own official polygon or within the explicit per-row distance threshold; no ownership in any CSC table, duplicate proposal, redirect, merge or dissolution. All failed gates held. Ended/future-start ancestry statements excluded.

sources.query: PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/> PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/> PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/> PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/> PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/> SELECT ?property ?label ?description WHERE { ?property a wikibase:Property ; rdfs:label ?label . FILTER(LANG(?label)="en") FILTER(REGEX(?label,"(China|Chinese|Philippine|Japanese|GSS|ONS|India|Indian|Nigeria|Indonesia|Pakistan|Bangladesh|Ethiopia|Congo|Egypt).*(code|ID)|municipality code", "i")) OPTIONAL { ?property schema:description ?description . FILTER(LANG(?description)="en") } }

PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/> PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/> PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/> PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/> PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/> SELECT ?property ?label ?description WHERE { ?property a wikibase:Property ; rdfs:label ?label . FILTER(LANG(?label)="en") FILTER(REGEX(?label,"(local (government|body)|LGD|BPS|Kemendagri|administrative.*code|division.*code|ONS|geographic.*code)","i")) OPTIONAL { ?property schema:description ?description . FILTER(LANG(?description)="en") } }

PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/> PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/> PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/> PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/> PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/> SELECT ?property ?label ?description WHERE { ?property a wikibase:Property ; rdfs:label ?label . FILTER(LANG(?label)="en") OPTIONAL { ?property schema:description ?description . FILTER(LANG(?description)="en") } FILTER(REGEX(CONCAT(?label,COALESCE(?description,"")),"(OCHA|Nigeria|p-code|humanitarian|Pakistan|Ethiopi|Egypt|PSGC|local government code)","i")) }

PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/> PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/> PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/> PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/> PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/> SELECT ?item ?literal ?rank WHERE { ?item p:P13971 ?statement . ?statement ps:P13971 ?literal ; wikibase:rank ?rank . }

PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/> PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/> PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/> PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/> PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/> SELECT ?item ?literal ?rank WHERE { ?item p:P442 ?statement . ?statement ps:P442 ?literal ; wikibase:rank ?rank . }
